subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be the canonical repair for this issue's dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final hook bypass?
rationale: Current source still reproduces the bug, but several open PRs implement different hook ownership boundaries and proof scopes, so creating another automated fix would add churn instead of resolving the maintainer choice.

options.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if its draft/conflict state, duplicate suffix-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher fix first
options.body: Use a smaller dispatcher-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 only if streamed-final coverage stays explicitly tracked for a follow-up.

options.title: Ask for a replacement branch
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidates only after a maintainer-owned branch covers both required paths without the existing readiness blockers.

recommendation.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if its draft/conflict state, duplicate suffix-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent main projection work touch the inspected dispatcher and Telegram lines, making this the best available routing candidate for the canonical-branch decision.
